PNC-EXP-031.concept: Selection creates the eligible group; the distinct roles are then assigned within that selected group.
lines: Assign {roleCount} distinct roles to different selected members: {roleAssignmentCount} ways.
The stages are sequential, so multiply: {selectionCount} × {roleAssignmentCount} = {answer}.

PNC-EXP-032.concept: First choose the group, then order every chosen member or object.

PNC-EXP-033.concept: The selection-only count is multiplied by the number of ordered role assignments within one selected group.
lines: For a fixed selected group of {selectedObjects}, assign {roleCount} distinct roles in {roleAssignmentCount} ways.
Therefore the role stage multiplies the selection count by {answer}.

PNC-EXP-034.concept: Test the stated bounded values in the complete selection-then-role expression.
lines: The mixed count is nCs × sPk, where selection is followed by ordered role assignment.
